attestations.note: The life page `https://www.saint.gr/2777/saint.aspx` heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 22 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder already keeps for the Romanian church, and the entry is the same man: bishop of Hierapolis in Phrygia, called equal to the apostles because he travelled and preached as the chief apostles did, who healed the daughter of the king of Rome of an evil spirit, brought hot springs out of the ground, preached through the cities of Syria and Mesopotamia and then in Lycaonia, Pisidia and the province of the Phrygians, and died in peace at seventy-two. **No `dates` object is proposed, because the page contradicts itself**: its heading prints «(95 - 167)» while its narrative opens «Ο Όσιος Αβέρκιος έζησε στα τέλη του 2ου αιώνα μ.Χ.», and the folder's Romanian life already places him in the reign of Marcus Aurelius. Relics are listed at the monastery of Panachrantou on Andros (his skull) and at Karakallou on Athos, Prousos in Eurytania and Phaneromeni on Salamis; no coordinate is proposed from that. Its first Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος πλ. α’, and its Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος δ’, are taken, both naming him; the «Έτερον Ἀπολυτίκιον», Ἦχος δ’, is the common of a hierarch «Κανόνα πίστεως», and an Οἶκος and a Κάθισμα are also printed — none of the three is drafted. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 04.11.2025 (22. октобар ст. ст.) — „Св. Аверкије равноапостолни.“

attestations.note: The day’s first entry, quoted whole with its closing full stop (BRIEF-SERBIAN section 4). The URL year is 2025, which is what `sr-civil.mjs` gives for the Julian 10-20 to 12-18. «равноапостолни» is the `equal-to-the-apostles` this folder already holds, «епископ» the `bishop` and the `office`, and the healings the `wonderworker`; `types` untouched. THE ONE DATE CHANGE OF THIS DAY, AND IT IS A WIDENING. The folder held `death` 167 flat, «c. 167», traditional. This entry puts his repose «крајем II столећа», AT THE END OF THE SECOND CENTURY, which is OUTSIDE the figure on file and not a vaguer version of it — 167 is the middle of that century, not its end. Two books cannot both be right and a reader does not pick the winner, so the interval becomes 167 to 200 and holds both. Width 33 years: neither `wide` nor `loose-basis`, so `date-audit.mjs` does not move on it. AND THE ENTRY CONTRADICTS ITSELF, WHICH IS WHY NEITHER END WAS PREFERRED. It opens «У време цара Антонина», in the time of the emperor Antoninus, and closes with the end of the second century; those two cannot both be the same span, and the emperor is nearer the 167 the folder already held than the century’s end is. An emperor is not a source for a year in any case, so nothing was derived from him — but his presence in the same paragraph is the reason this is recorded as a disagreement rather than as a correction. WHAT THE BOOK ADDS. He was bishop at HIERAPOLIS IN PHRYGIA, where the overwhelming majority were pagans, and he governed his small flock grieving in his heart over them and praying that God would turn them to the light of truth. At a NOISY IDOL FESTIVAL he was fired with zeal, WENT INTO THE IDOL TEMPLE AND SMASHED EVERY IDOL IN IT. When the enraged pagans were about to kill him, AT THAT VERY MOMENT THREE POSSESSED YOUTHS FELL UPON HIM, foaming and howling; he drove the demons out of them, the youths became whole and quiet, AND THE PAGANS TURNED THEIR ANGER INTO WONDER AND FIVE HUNDRED OF THEM WERE BAPTISED ON THE SPOT — and little by little the whole city believed. He RESTORED THE SIGHT OF THE BLIND MOTHER OF ПУБЛИЈЕ, the proconsul of the region, so that Publius and his mother and a multitude of others believed. In old age HE WAS CALLED TO ROME, WHERE HE HEALED THE EMPEROR’S MAD DAUGHTER. THE LORD CHRIST APPEARED TO HIM SEVERAL TIMES. Men came from near and far for his help in incurable torments; THE DEMONS NOT ONLY FEARED HIM BUT SERVED HIM AT HIS COMMAND; and BY THE LORD’S OWN DIRECTION he preached the Gospel through SYRIA AND MESOPOTAMIA as well. ONE PERSON NAMED AND NO FOLDER HOLDS HIM, WHICH IS RULING 3: Публије the proconsul, who believed with his mother. The mother and the emperor’s daughter are unnamed. No `related`, no `locations`: Hierapolis, Rome, Syria and Mesopotamia are named and none is a coordinate. THE FORM IS FREE: `foldchk.py` returns `NO FOLDER HOLDS THIS FORM` for «Аверкије». THE DAY’S THIRD ENTRY IS REFUSED WHOLE AND NO FOLDER GETS ANYTHING FROM IT. It is „Спомен чудотворног избављења Москве од Литванаца помоћу Пресвете Богородице.“ — the commemoration of the wonderful deliverance of Moscow from the Lithuanians by the help of the most holy Theotokos. A «Спомен» of an event is a feast and not a person, and section 5 puts it with «Пренос моштију» and «Обретење моштију»: the heading enumerates nobody, so it gets no row. Its body does name three people — св. Сергије Радоњежски, who appeared to a captive bishop Арсеније and promised that Moscow would be cleansed the next day, and кнез Василије Јованович, in whose time it happened — and section 4 and section 5 refuse all three: named in a body, absent from the heading. Nothing was written on `sergius-of-radonezh`. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion; the day’s verse is Bishop Nikolai’s own.

hymns.text: Îndreptător credinţei şi chip blândeţelor, învăţător înfrânârii te-a arătat pe tine, turmei tale, adevărul lucrurilor. Pentru aceasta ai dobândit cu smerenia cele înalte şi cu sărăcia cele bogate; Părinte Ierarhe Averchie, roagă pe Hristos Dumnezeu să mântuiască sufletele noastre.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfântului Ierarh Averchie, Episcopul Ierapolei, cel întocmai cu apostolii. The text is the common of a hierarch, with his name in it, as the page prints it.

english.text: A rule of faith and a model of meekness, a teacher of abstinence, the truth of things showed thee to thy flock. Therefore thou didst gain by humility the things on high, and by poverty the things that are rich; O Father and Hierarch Abercius, pray Christ God that our souls may be saved.

hymns.text: Ἀποστόλων τὸν ζῆλον ἐκμιμησάμενος, τὴ Ἐκκλησία ἐκλάμπεις ὡς ἑωσφόρος ἀστήρ, τὴν θεόσδοτον ἰσχὺν φαίνων τοὶς ἔργοις σοί, σὺ γὰρ θαυμάτων ἱερῶν, τᾶς δυνάμεις ἐνεργῶν, Ἀβέρκιε Ἱεράρχα, πρὸς εὐσέβειας εἰσόδους, τοὺς πλανωμένους καθωδήγησας.

source.text: saint.gr, «Όσιος Αβέρκιος ο Ισαπόστολος και θαυματουργός επίσκοπος Ιεράπολης» — Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος πλ. α’. Τὸν συνάναρχον Λόγον

english.text: Having imitated the zeal of the apostles, you shine out in the Church like the morning star, showing forth in your works the strength God gave you; for working the powers of sacred wonders, Abercius the hierarch, you led those who had gone astray to the gates of godliness.

hymns.text: Ὡς Ἱερέα μέγιστον, καὶ Ἀποστόλωv σύσκηvοv, ἡ Ἐκκλησία γεραίρει σε ἅπασα, ἡ τῶν πιστὼv Ἀβέρκιε, ἢv ταῖς σαῖς ἰκεσίαις περιφύλαττε μάκαρ, ἀκαταγώvιστον, ἐξ αἱρέσεως πάσης, καὶ ἄσειστοv πολυθαύμαστε.

source.text: saint.gr, «Όσιος Αβέρκιος ο Ισαπόστολος και θαυματουργός επίσκοπος Ιεράπολης» — Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος δ’. Ὡς ἀπαρχὰς (copied as the page prints it, Latin v for ν and all)

english.text: The whole Church of the faithful honours you, Abercius, as a greatest priest and a companion of the apostles; guard her by your entreaties, blessed one, unconquered by every heresy and unshaken, you of the many wonders.

hymns.text: Истины проповедник и чудотворец дивен показался еси,/ сирот отец и нищих заступник,/ бодрый пастырь словеснаго стада, бесом страшен,/ всех убо от тех нападений заступай, вопиющих ти:/ Аверкие отче наш,/ моли Христа Бога,/ да спасет души наша.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 22 октября ст. ст. — «Тропарь равноапостольного Аверкия, епископа Иерапольского, чудотворца»

english.text: You were shown to be a preacher of the truth and a wonderful worker of miracles, a father of orphans and a defender of the poor, a watchful shepherd of the rational flock, and terrible to demons. Defend from their assaults all who cry to you: Abercius our father, pray to Christ God that He may save our souls.

hymns.text: Яко священника превелиикаго и апостолов совсельника,/ Церковь почитает тя, вся верных, Аверкие:/ юже твоими молитвами соблюдай, блаженне,/ непобедиму и необуреваему от всякия ереси, и нескверну,/ яко приснопамятный.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 22 октября ст. ст. — «Кондак равноапостольного Аверкия, епископа Иерапольско»

english.text: As a most great priest and a fellow-dweller of the apostles the Church of all the faithful honours you, Abercius: keep her by your prayers, blessed one, unconquered and untroubled by every heresy and undefiled, you of ever-blessed memory.

death.display: c. 167, or the end of the 2nd century
death.note: The folder held «c. 167» flat before this reading. The Охридски пролог closes its entry «У дубокој старости представио се Господу своме љубљеноме, у граду Јерапољу, крајем II столећа» — at the end of the second century, which is outside 167 and not a vaguer form of it. The interval now holds both readings rather than preferring one. The same entry opens «У време цара Антонина», which is nearer the 167 than the century’s end is, so this book disagrees with itself as well as with the folder; an emperor is not a source for a year and nothing was derived from him.
